summary: Independent archive/hash/NumPy/terminal-data checks support each learned arm passing 5658/4850. Scope remains frozen-parent adaptation; extremal novelty, three effective contributions, ordinary joint training and full research goal are not established.

gt_provenance.details: Source traces ScanRefer JSON target IDs to stored scene-object boxes and masks; formal root GT comes from center_label/size_gts. Raw dataset files were not locally available for a new independent GT derivation.

score_normalization.details: IoU uses geometric union; accuracy uses 9508 expressions. Native softmax is candidate scoring, not normalization of performance by prediction statistics.

result_existence.details: All 1246 manifest files and 281198905 bytes hash-exact; 9508 rows, 1189 NPZs and 12170240 candidate IoUs independently checked. Logs and actual serialized terminal/Adam state agree on 3723 updates and 29778 unique fit rows.

dead_code.details: Controller runs train then formal. Entry calls PairedSpanRun.run; formal restore/evaluate calls native evaluator and checks its BBS hits. BBF diagnostics also run, but do not select reported outputs. Shared parent/apply_span_mixer is the actual full-validation path; full-wrapper integration has preflight evidence only.

scope.details: One fixed seed, two equal-capacity heads on a frozen parent, 29778 fit rows once, 9508 validation expressions/141 scenes. Not ordinary joint training, not three effective novel contributions, not a new holdout/test or Nr3D/Sr3D result.

eval_type.details: Dataset-GT grounding on the declared ScanRefer validation protocol. Mask row aggregates checked, not raw formal-mask recomputation.

findings.title: Metric gate is satisfied, three effective novel contributions are not established
findings.details: Extremal versus whole is +1/-1 hits; fixed-half itself passes both numerical gates. Learning versus fixed-half adds +2/+63 (extremal) or +1/+64 (whole), but those comparisons do not isolate three effective contributions.
findings.claim_impact: Blocks claims that this run establishes the requested three effective novel contributions or full research-goal completion; does not invalidate measured counts.

findings.title: Frozen-head adaptation is not ordinary joint training
findings.details: Only 29793-parameter span heads are optimized. Parent core, Mask and score are frozen; normal joint training and final Nr3D/Sr3D experiments are not evidenced as started/completed.
findings.claim_impact: Do not describe this result as ordinary native joint training or cross-benchmark validation.

findings.title: CPU assembly/head+Adam restoration is supported; original full-state bitwise identity and fresh GPU inference are not
findings.details: The successful helper builds a parent, clones that new parent, and compares wrapper state against that same clone plus terminal mixer. Random hidden BoundaryEvidenceReadback state is not compared to an original run archive, and constructor RNG is not reset. The ten geometry-refiner tensors are loaded explicitly; the wrapper checks both geometry/R output layers zero. The recovery receipt has no independent actual-import/source-hash transcript. No forward or CUDA RNG replay occurs.
findings.claim_impact: Read full_cpu_model_state_exact as assembly consistency; do not claim exact replay of every original run tensor or a fresh terminal cold GPU inference. No observed numerical contradiction follows from this inactive-zero-output-state limitation.

findings.title: Complete run intake is not a complete local raw-data/environment mirror
findings.details: All 1246 run artifacts are verified. Raw ScanRefer annotation/scene/superpoint files are not locally available; 249 of the 625 manifest dataset-source files are absent locally (all Python files are present). Source checks and captured GT support provenance, but this is not a new raw-data reconstruction.
findings.claim_impact: Retain this local-verification boundary; do not infer missing files or claim fully self-contained local reproducibility.

blocking_findings_scope: Acceptance of the archived numerical result with this explicitly limited frozen-parent ScanRefer scope; not promotion or full-goal acceptance.
